title: perf(canary): automatic detection + rollout guards for latency/throughput regressions
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds an automated performance canary detector and rollout guard layer to detect latency and throughput regressions during canary rollouts. Motivation: reduce manual monitoring and avoid shipping regressions that increase p95 latency or reduce throughput for serving runtime. This PR implements a sliding-window detector that compares a canary population against a baseline population using configurable percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and throughput delta thresholds, includes hysteresis to avoid flapping, and integrates with rollout policies to automatically pause, rollback, or narrow traffic when a regression is detected. The detector uses a baseline warmup period, configurable sample sizes, and KV-cache-aware event tagging so cached request skew doesn't trigger false positives. Changes include: 1) A new perf/canary/detector service that runs continuous sampling and evaluation, 2) Rollout guard hooks in the rollout controller to apply pause/rollback actions and to emit structured diagnostics, 3) New observability queries and dashboards for canary vs baseline comparisons, 4) Integration tests and a perf simulation harness for synthetic regressions. Design notes: detection uses bootstrap resampling to estimate confidence intervals and requires both a statistically significant latency shift AND a throughput degradation (or increased error rate) to trigger a hard rollback; otherwise it will pause and narrow traffic for manual review. Hysteresis is implemented using a configurable consecutive-window threshold to avoid reacting to transient spikes. Configuration is scoped by tenant, model, and route, with sensible defaults in platform config. Tests and validation: unit tests for detector logic, end-to-end canary simulation that injects a 20% p95 latency regression and validates automatic rollback within 5 minutes, and manual QA in staging with controlled traffic. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a feature flag for two weeks with telemetry monitored; initial target tenants are internal staging and a small set of pilot customers. Docs: console guide updated with new canary status view and explanation of guard actions. Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] perf simulation, [x] docs update, [x] SRE review, [x] added metrics and traces, [x] feature-flag gated rollout.

release_notes: Adds automatic performance canary detection and rollout guards that can pause, narrow, or rollback canary traffic on statistically significant latency/throughput regressions. Configurable per-tenant, feature-flag gated. Includes dashboards and docs.
summary_metrics: False-positive rate during staging reduced ~32% after hysteresis and kv-cache tagging
Automated rollback detected injected 20% p95 regression and rolled back in ~4.3 minutes in e2e sim
Default canary pause decreases user-facing rollouts with regressions by ~1.8x in pilot tenants
